text: 🇲🇽🔍 "If the education system had not been abandoned for years, there would not be the violence there is in the country. I can assure you of that." "The only way to address the cause that leads young people to approach a criminal group is to give them education and give them a scholarship. Where should young people be, on the street or in school?" — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Well-being Scholarships event, Villanueva, Zacatecas, Nov 21, 2026 "What do we have to do? Give them support so they stay in school, and also build more schools, because for years schools stopped being built." Sheinbaum spoke to high school and university students receiving the Benito Juárez and Gertrudis Bocanegra scholarships.
